author: Stahly
description:
Wondering whether it's finally time to upgrade from your smartphone camera for taking better shots of your minis? In part two of this series, I explain why a dedicated camera beats a smartphone, and walk you through dialling in your camera settings for razor-sharp miniature shots. I also share my camera, lens, and tripod recommendations across a range of budgets, so you can build the perfect setup to help you level up your miniature photography skills.

The post Mastering miniature photography #2: budget cameras, lenses & tripods to level up your shots appeared first on Tale of Painters.
title: Mastering miniature photography #2: budget cameras, lenses & tripods to level up your shots
